pages.text: 1. Villagers can now be interested in the emerald block by moving them from one place to another.$(br)2. It will not be possible to make an iron farm - metal no longer drops from golems.

3. Maximum Enchantments and diamond armor are no longer for sale.$(br)4. By healing a villager, you won't get a huge discount.$(br2)The villager have become more generous, they can sell animals in crates. There is not a 100% chance that a certain villager will have
an animal is sold in a box.$(br)Not everyone can be bought. All animals purchased from villagers are used to create other animals in crates, see crafts.
